outcome: Prevalence of Hypertensive Disorders in Pregnancy (HDP)
cohort: The study participants were 71,758 women whose pregnancies ended or who were admitted within 42 days of delivery in Nigerian referral level facilities.
finding: Hypertensive disorders in pregnancy (HDP) affected 6.4% of women in Nigeria, with predictors including older age, lower education, extremes of parity, and previous caesarean section or miscarriage, and were associated with significant adverse outcomes such as maternal death (3.7%) and stillbirths (11.9%).
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was identified as a predictor for hypertensive disorders in pregnancy.
